appended_inline_job:
compiler:
    if: ${{ inputs.route == 'loaded-account-arm64-compiler' }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
    concurrency:
      group: pinkha-loaded-account-compiler-${{ github.ref }}
      cancel-in-progress: false
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact compiler-producer controller
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            /Tools/AnyEngineValidation/loaded_account_witness/portable/
            /Tools/AnyEngineValidation/loaded_account_witness/native-compiler-support.json
            /.github/workflows/pinkha-loaded-account-arm64-compiler.yml

      - name: Acquire signed compiler packages and assemble an offline image
        env:
          EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ inputs.source_sha || github.sha }}
        run: python3 -B Tools/AnyEngineValidation/loaded_account_witness/portable/compiler_producer.py --execute

      - name: Preserve original compiler evidence and exact image bytes
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: Pinkha-Loaded-Account-ARM64-Compiler-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/pinkha-loaded-account-compiler
          include-hidden-files: true
          compression-level: 0
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
